definitions.gloss: investigation; thorough inquiry; getting to the bottom of
definitions.explanation: The act of thoroughly investigating and clarifying the truth or cause of something, especially accidents, incidents, or problems.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{究明|きゅうめい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To investigate the cause of the accident.

examples.japanese: ⟦{真相|しんそう}→真相：17447_shinsou⟧{究明|きゅうめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}まっている→高まる：02066_takamaru⟧。
examples.english: Calls for getting to the bottom of the truth are growing louder.

examples.japanese: ⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧{究明|きゅうめい}⟦にあたって→にあたって：22936_niatatte⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: A team of experts is working on investigating the cause.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word often used in news and official reports. Combines {究|きゅう} (to investigate thoroughly) and {明|めい} (to clarify). Commonly paired with ⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧ (cause) or ⟦{真相|しんそう}→真相：17447_shinsou⟧ (truth) to express the goal of the investigation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧{究明|きゅうめい} (investigation of the cause)
- ⟦{真相|しんそう}→真相：17447_shinsou⟧{究明|きゅうめい} (getting to the truth)
- ⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧{究明|きゅうめい} (fact-finding)
- {究明|きゅうめい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧あたる (to work on investigating)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧: investigation, survey — broader, more neutral
- ⟦{解明|かいめい}→解明：14164_kaimei⟧: elucidation, clarification — similar but emphasizes making clear
- ⟦{捜査|そうさ}→捜査：03688_sousa⟧: criminal investigation — specifically by police or authorities
